messages:
Fiona T.: uploaded a slim prototype for stacked-channel visibility — figma: https://www.figma.com/file/stacked-proto. Goal: make thresholds, order, and suppression clear in a dense list. feedback welcome. Marco J.: nice baseline. big issue: compact overflow shows '+4' only. that hides whether some channels are suppressed. suggest '+4 (1 suppressed)'. quick win. Alina P.: agree. tooltips are used for thresholds now which is bad for keyboard/SR. inline microchips like 'CRITICAL 90% (5m)' keep density but expose the numbers. Devon (eng): implementation notes: timeline pill sounds good — 48px bar with diagonal stripes for suppressed ranges + fallback text 'Suppressed 00:006:00 local'. ensure striping via SVG and provide aria-describedby. Drag handles need tabindex=0 so keyboard users can reorder. accessibility-bot: auto-scan: issues found: 1) small chips contrast 3.3:1 (fail). 2) preview live region missing role=status. 3) drag handle not focusable. Recommend chips >=4.5:1,
Preview...
, and tabindex=0 + 3px visible focus ring for handles. Fiona T.: will update: 1) overflow becomes '+4 (1 suppressed)', 2) inline chips 'CRITICAL 90% (5m)', 3) add timeline pill + timezone toggle, 4) aria-live role=status and suppression-desc id, 5) tabbable handles and stronger contrast. Marco J.: one UX nit: when threshold is edited show a small undo snackbar anchored to preview: 'Threshold set to 85% — Undo' with role=alert and keyboard-focusable undo. cuts accidental-change anxiety. Alina P.: microcopy: ditch 'Silence window' — use 'Quiet hours (suppression window)'. for compact label just 'Quiet hours'. Devon (eng): we'll wire the aria bits. suggestion for SR markup:
Suppressed between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM local time.
Preview updated: triggers at 90% for 5 minutes; notifies PagerDuty then Slack; email suppressed.
Fiona T.: thanks all — I'll push v2 with these changes and request a final a11y pass before user sessions. :thumbsup:
